title: Industrial Design Internship (Power Tools, REF300501D)
note: Power-tool design internship; posting is in German and asks for fluent German, very good English and current university enrollment.

facts.summary: Six-month on-site industrial design internship with the Bosch Power Tools UX design team near Stuttgart.
facts.duties: Generate ideas for electric power tool concepts, develop detailed design concepts, build 2D/3D models and renderings, and work with market research and innovation colleagues.
facts.requirements: Enrolled industrial/product design student; hand sketching and model making; Adobe CS, Rhino, SolidWorks, KeyShot; fluent German and very good English; work/residence permit if applicable.
facts.apply: Apply online with CV, transcript, enrollment proof, exam regulations and portfolio.
